entities.summary: Grace Zumwinkle is an American professional ice hockey player for the Minnesota Frost of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and the United States national team. She is a 2022 Winter Olympic silver medalist and was named to the roster for the 2026 Winter Olympics. Zumwinkle has won five World Championship medals, including gold at the 2025 World Championship and silver medals in 2021, 2022, and 2024.
